description: This file defines the abstract base class AbstractIntegerDistribution for integer-valued discrete distributions within the Apache Commons Math library. It provides common implementations for probability calculations, sampling, and utilities for subclasses that represent specific distributions.

classes.name: AbstractIntegerDistribution
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing common functionality for integer-valued discrete distributions, including probability calculations, sampling methods, and inverse cumulative probability.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the probability that X falls between two bounds x0 and x1 inclusive.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the inverse cumulative distribution function for a given probability p.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution using inverse transform sampling.

methods.name: reseedRandomGenerator
methods.description: Resets the seed of the random number generator.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the probability mass function at x.
